scripts.dev:setup: pnpm run rebuild:electron && pnpm run build-worker
scripts.dev:full: pnpm run dev:setup && pnpm run dev:hot
scripts.build: electron-vite build && pnpm run copy-migrations && pnpm run build-worker
scripts.build:app: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run prepare-deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder
scripts.build:deb: pnpm run prepare-deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux deb
scripts.build:appimage: pnpm run prepare-deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run prepare-deps && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.copy-migrations: mkdir -p dist/main/database/migrations && cp -r src/main/database/migrations/*.js dist/main/database/migrations/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build-worker: mkdir -p dist/main/stt/workers && tsc src/main/stt/workers/sttWorker.ts src/main/stt/workers/fileTranscriberWorker.ts --outDir dist/main/stt/workers --module commonjs --target es2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --resolveJsonModule --moduleResolution node || true
